correctness.rationale: For uniform G(n,m), a particular labeled k-vertex tree component consumes k-1 internal edges and forbids all crossing edges; outside is conditional G(n-k,r) with r=m-k+1. This directly proves E T_k=choose(n,k)k^(k-2)choose(Q,r)/choose(M,m) and Cov(I,T_k)=E T_k[(n-k)rho(B,Q,r)-n rho(A,M,m)]. Ratio of conditional-to-unconditional isolate means obeys R_{m+1}/R_m=(B-r)/(Q-r)*(M-m)/(A-m) when numerator positive. Independently expanded cross-product (Q-r)(A-m)-(B-r)(M-m)=(n-k-1)(k(n-3)+2)/2+kr>0 for all meaningful steps; subsequent numerator vanishes permanently. Thus signs positive, optional zero, negative over feasible m, with k=2 initially zero. For k/n->alpha in(0,1), at m=k-1 rho(A,M,k-1)->e^-2alpha yielding unique interior positive root alpha≈0.79681213 of 1-alpha=e^-2alpha; no boundary-alpha claim. Fresh SymPy zero residual in cross-product and exact sign-order tests for 4<=n<9 confirmed algebra, not used as all-n proof.
